text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. When you have several tasks, it is important to prioritize them. Decide which tasks are most urgent and do those first. You should also manage the scope of your work. Sometimes a task is too big, so you may need to break it into smaller parts or agree on a simpler result. Finally, communication is key. If you think you cannot finish on time, tell your manager or team early. They may be able to help or change the deadline. By planning ahead and speaking up, you can reduce stress and meet your deadlines more successfully.
